normative_language: MUST/MUST NOT are mandatory; SHOULD is recommended; MAY is optional.
principles: No single row-count rule decides meaningful complexity.
A class is assigned by a noncompensatory multidimensional profile after deduplication and ablation.
Execution burden cannot upgrade meaningful complexity.
Proposed interactions and microtexture are not physical results.
Hedonic value, broad appeal, similarity, and beauty are separate evaluation domains.
A target-specific identity lower bound overrides generic row bands when authoritative evidence exists.

claim_levels.DESIGN_ONLY: Architecture and computational checks only. No physical or sensory claim.
claim_levels.SOURCE_SUPPORTED_DESIGN: Design is linked to source evidence, but formula-specific physical effects remain unobserved.
claim_levels.PHYSICALLY_OBSERVED: Relevant physical batches and repeated observations exist; trained-panel claims are still excluded unless present.
claim_levels.TRAINED_SENSORY_CONFIRMED: Claim-appropriate trained sensory evidence is linked. This still does not imply broad commercial appeal without a relevant sample.

counting_rules.canonical_odor_identity: Count once after alias, supplier-label, and duplicate-strength normalization.
counting_rules.duplicate_strengths: Count once for meaningful identity; each preparation may increase execution complexity.
counting_rules.technical_materials: Do not count toward meaningful odor complexity.
counting_rules.opaque_product_basis: Count as one product-basis identity. Never expand undisclosed internal components.
counting_rules.disclosed_premix: Count deduplicated odor components, not the premix label; premix preparation counts in execution complexity.
counting_rules.opaque_premix: Count once as product basis if it has a defensible function; internal identities remain unknown.
counting_rules.naturals: Count each distinct species/process/chemotype/product-basis material once. Two lots of the same natural default to one identity unless intentional independent function is physically demonstrated. Lot differences remain provenance and resilience variables.
counting_rules.microtexture_proposed: Does not count toward effective post-ablation complexity.
counting_rules.microtexture_physically_confirmed: May count when a repeatable omission or perturbation effect is recorded.
counting_rules.trace_rows: Count only when identity, function, evidence state, and an ablation/test disposition are explicit.
counting_rules.target_inventory_separation: Missing inventory may block a build but may not delete or alter an evidence-faithful target identity.

legacy_row_bands.v3_disposition: Compatibility descriptors and compression-review triggers, not universal v3 pass gates.
hard_when: The artifact explicitly claims v2 compatibility.
An authoritative target roster or function graph establishes a required identity count.
The requested class relies on rows that disappear after deduplication or ablation.
legacy_row_bands.below_band_action: Open COMPRESSION_REVIEW. The formula may still classify in v3 only when the full multidimensional profile survives ablation and no physical construct is falsely passed.
legacy_row_bands.above_band_action: Open PADDING_REVIEW when functional-row ratio is below 0.90, proposed microtexture exceeds 0.20 of claimed effective rows, or unassigned/duplicate rows exist.

hard_failures: class depends on duplicate strengths or technical rows
hedonic claim inferred from formula architecture
physical claim passed without physical evidence
shared_integrity_rules.class_retention_rule: The assigned class MUST still be met after deduplication, exclusion of proposed microtexture, and computational ablation of redundant rows.

COMPACT.human_definition: A bounded, efficient module or perfume whose purpose does not require broad multidimensional layering.
required_conditions: Evidence integrity passes for the scope.
The artifact does not claim high-complexity or orchestral status.
No padding is used to imitate complexity.
COMPACT.physical_claim_cap: DESIGN_ONLY unless physical or sensory records are linked.

LAYERED.human_definition: Multiple systems and phases are intentionally connected, but the architecture is not yet broadly distributed enough for high-complexity status.
required_conditions: At least one recognizer path is explicit.
No requested dimension depends on proposed microtexture.
LAYERED.physical_claim_cap: SOURCE_SUPPORTED_DESIGN unless physical observations are linked.

HIGH_COMPLEXITY.human_definition: A distributed architecture with broad structural, temporal, interaction, textural, and contrast articulation that survives pruning.
required_conditions: Class survives computational ablation without counting proposed microtexture.
Physical effects remain HOLD until observed.
HIGH_COMPLEXITY.physical_claim_cap: SOURCE_SUPPORTED_DESIGN unless physical observations are linked.

ORCHESTRAL.human_definition: A high-complexity architecture with multiple independently legible motifs, distributed control, several temporal handoffs, and rich cross-system articulation.
required_conditions: An orchestral empirical claim requires repeated physical time-course and trained sensory evidence.
ORCHESTRAL.physical_claim_cap: SOURCE_SUPPORTED_DESIGN until repeated physical and trained sensory evidence exists.

UNCLASSIFIED_HOLD.human_definition: Authority, identity, evidence, or physical boundaries prevent honest classification.
required_conditions: Used whenever a material gap is filled by imagination or a required authority is unresolved.

classification_algorithm: Lock artifact scope and source authority.
Apply row-accounting rules and exclude technical, duplicate, alias, and redundant rows.
Exclude proposed microtexture from effective post-ablation complexity.
Evaluate all ten vector dimensions with evidence and claim-level caps.
Assign the highest class whose entire minimum profile is met after ablation.
Apply legacy row-band compatibility status and open compression or padding review when triggered.
Cap the claim level by available physical and trained sensory evidence.
Report every HOLD; never average conflicting thresholds or missing authorities.
